name: How much does a typical kitchen remodel cost in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: How much does a typical kitchen remodel cost in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A typical **full kitchen remodel in Los Angeles County usually ranges from about $25,000 to $120,000+**, depending on size, layout changes, and finish level. Smaller ‘pull-and-replace’ projects can fall near the low end, while structural changes and high-end finishes drive costs up.

Costs in LA are higher than many other cities due to labor rates, permit requirements, and material pricing. Think in ranges, not exact numbers, until you’ve finalized the design and scope.

Key factors:
- Size of the kitchen and whether walls or plumbing are moved
- Cabinet type (stock, semi-custom, custom) and countertop materials
- Appliance package, lighting, and ventilation upgrades
- Condition of existing electrical, plumbing, and framing

Start by defining a total budget and a 10–15% contingency, then share that with your contractor so the design stays realistic. Ask for a detailed line-item estimate so you can see where money is going and what you can adjust. A reputable contractor will help you value-engineer the project without compromising safety.

A thoughtful budget conversation early on usually leads to a more satisfying result and fewer mid-project surprises.

Smaller pull-and-replace updates are at the low end; structural changes, custom cabinets, and luxury finishes push costs higher. Always plan a 10–15% contingency.
